title: Moment compression of visited-range distributions for extensive-lesion robustness in layered Markov chains
description: Reproducibility package: frozen preregistered protocol, analysis code, frozen data outputs, and SHA-256 manifests for the study of extensive-lesion robustness in feed-forward Markov chains. Supports quick reproduction from frozen outputs and full from-scratch reproduction of the pipeline.
